Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.

SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OPEN_VEINS.title: Open Veins
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HEMORRHAGE.title: Hemorrhage
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HEMORRHAGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {PerBleed:diff()} for each [gold]Bleed[/gold] on the target.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STEEL_ENDURANCE.title: Steel Endurance
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STEEL_ENDURANCE.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus {PerHeavy:diff()} for each piece of heavy armor you wear.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LIVING_FORTRESS.title: Living Fortress

SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MEASURED_STRIKE.title: Measured Strike

[gold]Weapon[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
With a one-handed weapon, draw 1 card.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SWORD_AND_BOARD.title: Sword and Board
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SWORD_AND_BOARD.descripti:
[gold]Weapon[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
With a one-handed weapon and a shield, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OVERHEAD_SMASH.title: Overhead Smash

[gold]Weapon[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
With a two-handed weapon, deal {TwoHandedBonus:diff()} more.

[gold]Weapon[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.

SLAYTHEREQUIEM-THIRD_STEP.description:
[gold]Weapon[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you played 2 or more cards this turn, deal it again.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WIND_RHYTHM.title: Wind Rhythm
